security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Thermal image viewer and report tool
bundle.longDescription: Open radiometric thermal images and FLIR SEQ/CSQ video from FLIR, DJI Zenmuse, Fluke, InfiRay/Topdon and HTI cameras. Correct emissivity and other parameters, measure with spots, areas, polygons and the magic wand, use formulas, alarms and isotherms, find hot spots automatically, stitch panoramas, and create PDF or HTML reports from templates. Free, offline and open source.
